name: Event Frequency 8 Code
definition: Specifies the regularity of an event.

YEAR.name: Annual
YEAR.definition: Event takes place every year or once a year.

FOMN.name: Every Four Months
FOMN.definition: Event takes place every four months or three times a year.

TOMN.name: Every Two Months
TOMN.definition: Event takes place every two months.

TOWK.name: Every Two Weeks
TOWK.definition: Event takes place every two weeks.

TYEA.name: Every Two Years
TYEA.definition: Event takes place every two years.

INDA.name: Intra Day
INDA.definition: Event takes place several times a day.

MNTH.name: Monthly
MNTH.definition: Event takes place every month or once a month.

QUTR.name: Quarterly
QUTR.definition: Event takes place every three months or four times a year.

SEMI.name: Semi Annual
SEMI.definition: Event takes place every six months or two times a year.

TWMN.name: Twice A Month
TWMN.definition: Event takes place two times a month.

WEEK.name: Weekly
WEEK.definition: Event takes place once a week.
